# The God's Tool

> A web app that cleans messy data. Upload a CSV, link a Google Sheet or connect a database, review the problems it finds, and fix them by describing what you want in plain English. Cleaning steps can be saved, edited as SQL and run again on a schedule.

It is made for freelancers, analysts, small teams and companies who regularly receive messy spreadsheets and exports, and for data teams that need to keep database tables clean on a schedule.

## When it fits
- Cleaning a messy CSV export: duplicates, blanks, broken dates, inconsistent names, numbers stored as text.
- Fixing a Google Sheet without writing formulas or scripts.
- Cleaning a MySQL, PostgreSQL, BigQuery or MongoDB table, including databases behind a firewall, with reviewable SQL.
- Turning a bank statement PDF into a table that is checked row by row against the statement's own running balances, with doubtful rows flagged next to the PDF (paid plans and trial).
- Repeating the same cleanup every week or month, with an alert when a column changes shape.

## When it does not fit
- It is software you operate yourself, not a done-for-you cleaning service.
- It does not read scanned or photographed statements, or statements that print no running balance, and it does not import into accounting software.
- It is not a data warehouse, BI dashboard or ETL platform for moving large volumes of data.

## Key facts
- Free plan: up to 3 sources, CSV files up to 5 MB, 5,000 rows per run, 1 pipeline. New accounts get a 14-day trial with every feature included, no card needed.
- Paid plans (USD per month): Lite $19, Starter $39, Pro $79, Team $199.
- Credits: pay as you go with no subscription. One credit pays for one AI action, about $0.03 each, minimum top-up $2.
- Quotes: bulk credits, team plans, database or API sources and invoicing are quoted by email. Request one at https://thegodstool.com/#quote or write to contact@thegodstool.com. Quotes cover access to the tool, not a done-for-you cleaning service.
- Sources: CSV, Google Sheets, MySQL, PostgreSQL, BigQuery, MongoDB, AWS (RDS, S3, DynamoDB, Redshift), Google Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, Databricks, REST APIs, Google Analytics 4.
- Security: data is encrypted in transit and is not sold. AI features run in private mode: Claude (Anthropic) receives the instruction, column names and a structural summary, never actual rows. See https://thegodstool.com/privacy.html
